info.title: Tikkit API
info.description: Conventions: docs/api-conventions.md. Errors use the ErrorEnvelope schema; lists use `limit`/`cursor` and return a Page. Authentication is the HttpOnly `tikkit_session` cookie; every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE must send `X-Requested-With: tikkit` or is rejected with 403 `csrf_rejected` (docs/auth.md).

get.summary: All accounts, newest first (Admin only).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-100 (default 25). Out-of-range values are clamped.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page.

post.summary:
Deactivates an account (Admin only): login is refused and all its sessions
end immediately. Tickets and audit history are kept. The last active Admin
cannot be deactivated.
Reactivates an account (Admin only).

Re-queues every `failed` row. Rows keep their idempotency key, so a message
the relay already accepted is never sent twice.

Signs in with username and password. Every failure is the same
`invalid_credentials`, whether the account is unknown, deactivated, or the password wrong.

200.description: Signed in; a new session cookie is set

post.summary: Revokes the current session and clears the cookie. Idempotent.

get.summary: The signed-in account.

patch.summary: Updates the signed-in account's email and/or language.

post.summary: Changes the password, revokes every session of this account, and issues a fresh one.

204.description: Password changed; new session cookie set

post.summary:
Starts password recovery for a username. Always `202` with no body, whether
or not the account exists, so the response reveals nothing. An active
account gets a one-hour, single-use link at its stored email when SMTP is configured.

Sets a new password with a recovery token, invalidates every other recovery
token of the account, and revokes all its sessions. Sign in afterwards.

get.summary:
The active catalog for the shared ticket form: unarchived categories,
priorities, fields, and choices in display order. Any signed-in account.
The whole catalog including archived entries (Admin only).

post.summary: Adds a category at the end of the order (Admin only).

put.summary: Sets the display order of all categories (Admin only).

409.description: `conflict`: the IDs are not exactly the current categories (reload)

patch.summary:
Renames, sets "Skip AI automatically", archives, or restores a category
(Admin only). Submitted tickets keep their snapshot of the category.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is serving. Touches no dependencies.

post.summary:
Adds a conditional field at the end of the order (Admin only). A `select`
field needs at least one choice or `allow_other`.

put.summary: Sets the display order of all conditional fields (Admin only).

409.description: `conflict`: the IDs are not exactly the current fields (reload)

patch.summary:
Edits, archives, or restores a conditional field, its choices, and the
categories that reveal it (Admin only). The kind cannot change.

get.summary: Invitations newest first, optionally including all historical statuses (Admin only).

parameters.name: include_history
parameters.description: Include accepted/expired/revoked invitations. Default false preserves the pending-only view.

post.summary:
Creates a single-use invitation (Admin only). The role is fixed here and
applied on acceptance; the invitee cannot change it.

Creates the invited account with the invitation's role and signs it in.
The invitation is consumed only when this commits; validation errors and
username collisions leave it usable. Concurrent acceptance has one winner.

Checks an invitation token without consuming it. The token travels in the
body, never in the URL, so it stays out of request logs.
Reissue replaces an unused invitation atomically; concurrent/replayed requests fail.

Revokes a pending invitation (Admin only). Used or already revoked
invitations are `not_found`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-100 (default 25). Out-of-range values are clamped.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page.

post.summary:
Marks one of the caller's visible notifications read. Idempotent; anything
else (another account's, or one whose ticket is no longer visible) is `404`.

get.summary: This OpenAPI document.

post.summary: Adds a priority level at the end of the order (Admin only).

put.summary: Sets the display order of all priority levels (Admin only).

409.description: `conflict`: the IDs are not exactly the current priorities (reload)

patch.summary: Renames, archives, or restores a priority level (Admin only).

get.summary:
Staff queue page, filtered and ordered as requested. `view=team` for a
non-Admin is always their own team (another `team_id` is `404`).

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Default `general`.

parameters.name: team_id
parameters.description: `team` view, Admin only: restrict to one team.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: One of the open statuses, `closed`, or `cancelled`; default: all open statuses.

parameters.name: unassigned
parameters.description: Only tickets without an individual assignee.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Search text, up to 200 characters: a ticket reference (`123` or `#123`), or
at least 3 characters matched anywhere in the subject, description, category,
requester username or display name, or message text the caller may read.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-100 (default 25).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page.

422.description: `validation_failed`: `q` is `too_short` or `too_long`, or the cursor is invalid

get.summary: Open work counts for the caller's queue tabs.

Readiness: the database answers and its schema matches this build.
Reports stable check identifiers only, never connection details.

503.description: A required dependency is unavailable or incompatible

get.summary: The caller's saved views, by name (at most 50, not paged).

post.summary:
Saves the caller's current filters under a name. Every filter must apply now
(`422`, `filters.<name>: invalid`).

422.description: `name` is `required`, `too_long`, or `taken`; `saved_views: too_many`; or a filter is `invalid`

delete.summary: Deletes one of the caller's views; anyone else's is `404`.

post.summary:
Upload one screenshot as the raw request body (`Content-Type: image/png`,
`image/jpeg`, or `image/webp`). It stays private to the uploader until
attached by submission; unreferenced uploads expire after 24 hours.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description:
Original file name; only a safe base name is kept. Its extension, if
any, must match the image format.

requestBody.description: Raw image bytes, at most 10 MiB

400.description: `bad_request` (incomplete upload or body read exceeded 30 seconds)

500.description: `internal` (storage or database failure; a commit acknowledgement may be lost)

get.summary: Metadata of a screenshot the caller may currently read.

delete.summary:
Delete an own pending upload immediately. Attached screenshots are frozen
(`409`); so are uploads still referenced by an editable draft: save the draft
without it first (or just save it; unreferenced uploads expire on their own).

409.description: `conflict` (attached to a ticket or referenced by a draft)

get.summary: The same bytes as an attachment download.
Inline image for `` previews. Access is rechecked on every request and never cached, so revoked access applies to old URLs immediately.
The saved outbound connection, or `connection: null` (Admin only).

put.summary:
Creates or replaces the outbound connection (Admin only).
A missing `password` keeps the stored one. The response never contains it.

delete.summary: Removes the outbound connection (Admin only). Later mail is not sent.

post.summary:
Sends a test message through the saved connection (Admin only).
The recipient must be this Admin's email or the configured sender address.
Transport security is the saved STARTTLS or implicit TLS setting; it is not
taken from the request. Failures use stable codes and do not echo credentials.

get.summary: Whether first-admin setup is still open.

post.summary: Creates the first Admin and signs them in. Works exactly once per deployment.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-100 (default 25). Out-of-range values are clamped.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page.

get.summary: Active drafts of this account only (including for staff/Admin accounts).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-100 (default 25). Out-of-range values are clamped.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page.

post.summary: Save incomplete input privately. Retained until the owner deletes or submits it.

get.summary: Resume one owned draft. Other accounts, including Admins, get `404`.

delete.summary: Delete an owned, unsubmitted draft at the last read version.

patch.summary: Replace editable draft input using the last read version. Never edits a submitted ticket.

post.summary:
Submit exactly the owned draft version last read. On failure the draft stays
editable with the same version and input; success leaves an immutable tombstone.

get.summary:
Own submitted tickets, newest first, including final AI-solved history.
This is a requester list for every role, never a staff queue or Admin report.

parameters.name: created_from
parameters.description: Inclusive creation timestamp.

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Exclusive creation timestamp.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1–100 (default 25).

post.summary:
Validate and submit new input. Owner is always the signed-in account. A
key reused with different input is `409`; identical retries replay the receipt.

Applies one change to up to 50 tickets, each independently authorized, locked,
and checked for staleness. A retry never applies twice: an applied item moved
its `updated_at`, so repeating it reports `conflict` and writes nothing.

422.description: `tickets` is empty (`required`), over 50 (`too_many`), or repeats a ticket (`duplicate`)

get.summary:
A ticket the caller may see: their own (requester view, any status, any
role), or as staff under the ticket policy. Drafts, AI-stage and AI-solved
records are hidden from operators; dispatched tickets from other teams.

404.description: `not_found` (missing or not visible to the caller)

post.summary:
Apply one lifecycle decision atomically. Stale/duplicate proposal decisions
return 409; policy is read again by the lifecycle inside the transaction.

403.description: Current policy or actor denies the action

get.summary:
Poll target for open ticket pages: reload the ticket when `version` differs
from the one loaded with it. Same visibility as `GET /api/tickets/{id}`, checked
on every call, so a transfer, team removal, or revoked session stops it (`404`/`401`).
Internal notes count only in the staff view.

404.description: `not_found` (missing or not visible to the caller)

post.summary:
Dispatch, transfer, return to general intake, claim, assign, or unassign.
Checks: visibility (`404`), self-handling (`403`), stale `expected_updated_at`
(`409`), the rest of the ticket policy (`403`), then the target (`422`).
Concurrent changes serialize on the ticket row; the later one is stale (`409`).

403.description: Not allowed on this ticket (role, team, claim, self-handling, status)

422.description: `team_id` or `assignee_account_id` is not an eligible target

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-100 (default 25). Out-of-range values are clamped.

parameters.name: cursor

post.summary:
Add a private internal note. Author, staff role, and visibility come from
the server's current ticket policy, never client-supplied fields.

201.description: Committed private note (same receipt on identical retry)

post.summary:
Send a public reply. Ownership takes precedence over staff role: the ticket's
submitting account always speaks as requester. No AI work is scheduled.

201.description: Committed message (same receipt on identical retry)

409.description: Requester ticket not open, or key reused with different input

post.summary:
Staff status work and priority changes. Thin over [`lifecycle::transition`]
(visibility, self-handling, claimed-ticket and policy rules live there and in
[`authz::authorize_ticket`]); stale clients get `409` and nothing is written.

403.description: Not in charge of the ticket, self-handling, or policy denies

email.description: Contact address only; never identifies an account.

choice_id.description: Set when a listed choice was picked; `None` for typed text.

value.description: The choice label or the typed text.

oneOf.description:
Send the ticket to an active team (from the general queue or another team).
Leaves the individual assignee empty.
Put a team ticket back into shared intake: no team, no assignee.
Take an unclaimed ticket of the caller's team.
Team Lead (own team) or Admin: (re)assign to an active member of the ticket's team.
Team Lead (own team) or Admin: clear the individual assignee.

AssignmentAction.description:
One explicit team or assignee change, with the `updated_at` the client last
loaded (`TicketDetail.updated_at`); a newer change is `409 conflict`.

AssignmentChange.description: One immutable team/assignee change (`assignment_changed` event). Names are current.

action.description:
`dispatch`, `return_to_general`, `claim`, `assign`, or `unassign` (also
when an account lost eligibility; then `reason` says why).

AssignmentReceipt.description: What changed, safe to show even when the caller lost access by the change.

visible.description:
The caller can still open the ticket as staff. False after a transfer to a
team the caller is not in: further reads are `404`.

BulkAssignee.description: An eligible assignee for bulk assignment.

BulkChange.description:
The change applied to every listed ticket; the same rules as the single-ticket
`assignment` and `staff-actions` endpoints.

oneOf.description:
`null` when applied. Otherwise what the single-ticket endpoint would answer:
`not_found` (not visible), `forbidden` (visible, not allowed), `conflict`
(changed since listed, or nothing to change), `validation_failed` (not an
eligible target for this ticket), or `internal`.

BulkOptions.description: Targets the bulk bar offers. Affordances only: each item is rechecked.

assignees.description:
Active staff members a caller may assign: a Team Lead's own team, every
active team for an Admin, nobody otherwise.

BulkResponse.description: One result per requested ticket, in request order.

BulkTicket.description: A ticket and the `updated_at` the client listed it with (`QueueTicket.updated_at`).

CancellationPolicy.description: When the owning requester may cancel a submitted open ticket.

skip_ai.description:
"Skip AI automatically": submissions go straight to the operator queue
with no AI provider call, whatever the requester-skip setting says.

archived.description: `true` hides it from new tickets; `false` restores it. Existing tickets are unaffected.

Choice.description: A select option. Its ID is stable: renaming keeps it, and it is archived, never deleted.

id.description: An existing choice of this field to update; omit to add a new choice.

label.description: 1-100 characters, unique among the field's active choices.

ClosureReason.description: How a resolved ticket was closed (`tickets.closure_reason`). A timeout is never an acceptance.

email.description: Optional recipient. With SMTP configured the link is emailed there.

oneOf.description: Language of the email and preselected account language. Default `en`.
Role of the account created from this invitation. Default `user`.

name.description: 1-80 characters after trimming, unique per account.

emailed.description: Whether an email was queued (SMTP configured and an email given).

url.description: Single-use acceptance link. Shown only now; only its hash is stored.

version.description: The version last read; stale writes return `409 conflict`.

message.description: Safe English fallback text; translate by `code` instead of showing this.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error codes. Never translated; clients map them to text.

fields.description: Invalid input fields (dotted paths) and their stable error codes.

request_id.description: Same value as the `x-request-id` response header.

IntakeAnswer.description:
One conditional answer on the shared form: the `choice_id` of a `select`
field, or `text` (a `text` field, or a `select` field's free-text alternative).

allow_other.description: `select` only: a free-text answer may be given instead of a choice.

category_ids.description: The categories whose selection reveals this field.

guidance.description: Help text shown with the field; may be empty.

required.description: Required while visible. Hidden fields are never required.

choices.description:
The complete choice list in display order. Existing choices left out are
archived, never deleted, so their IDs stay valid for existing tickets.

IntakeSnapshot.description:
What a submitted ticket stores: names, labels, and answers as they were at
submission, so later edits and archival never rewrite history, and the AI
route (`skip_ai`) is fixed for the whole attempt.

answers.description: Answers to fields visible for the category, in display order.

InvitationPreview.description: What an invitee sees before accepting. Opening a link never consumes it.

Language.description: Machine identifiers published in the contract; display text is localized by clients.

author_account_id.description: Immutable account identity for staff consumers; null in requester responses.

author_display_name.description: User-authored plain text; render as text, never HTML.

body.description: Original plain text; render as text, never HTML or Markdown.

skip_ai.description: Default `false`: follow the organization AI policy.

category_ids.description: The categories that reveal this field.

choices.description: `select` only, in display order (new choices, so without `id`).

href.description: Portal path of the ticket; opening it still requires current access.

title.description: System text in the caller's language.

ids.description: Every ID of this kind, archived ones included, in the new display order.

allow_reopening.description: Human-closed tickets only. AI-solved records remain permanently non-reopenable.

requester_cancellation_policy.description: Before work starts uses the first human work-start event, never current assignment. Every cancellation requires a reason.

resolution_confirmation_hours.description: Positive elapsed hours, default 168. Future proposals snapshot this policy; timeout closure is not requester acceptance.

timezone.description: UTC or an IANA area/timezone name supported by PostgreSQL; timestamps remain UTC.

Page_AccountSummary.description: One page of a list. `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

Page_Draft.description: One page of a list. `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

Page_Invitation.description: One page of a list. `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

Page_Message.description: One page of a list. `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

author_account_id.description: Immutable account identity for staff consumers; null in requester responses.

author_display_name.description: User-authored plain text; render as text, never HTML.

body.description: Original plain text; render as text, never HTML or Markdown.

Page_Notification.description: One page of a list. `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

href.description: Portal path of the ticket; opening it still requires current access.

title.description: System text in the caller's language.

Page_QueueTicket.description: One page of a list. `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

priority_id.description:
The current effective priority; the requester's original choice stays in
the ticket's intake snapshot.

Page_Team.description: One page of a list. `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

Page_TicketAssignmentView.description: One page of a list. `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

items.description:
Public handling details shown to a ticket's requester. `team_name: null`
means the shared general queue; `assignee_display_name: null` means unassigned.

Page_TicketSummary.description: One page of a list. `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

items.description: Minimal requester history. No staff-only metadata; all roles see only their own.

PriorityChange.description: One immutable change of the effective priority (`priority_changed` event).

actor_account_id.description: Staff view only; `null` in the requester view.

archived.description: `true` hides it from new tickets; `false` restores it. Existing tickets are unaffected.

QueueCounts.description: Open work counts per view, under the same visibility as the lists.

team.description: The caller's team; for an Admin, every dispatched ticket.

version.description:
Opaque change marker, compare for equality only: changes whenever an open
ticket the caller may see enters, leaves, or changes, or the caller's role or
team changes. Queue pages poll this endpoint and reload when it differs.

QueueFilters.description: The `GET /api/queue` filters a view applies (no cursor or page size).

QueueSort.description: Fixed orders; ties break on `(created_at, id)`.

priority_id.description:
The current effective priority; the requester's original choice stays in
the ticket's intake snapshot.

QueueView.description: Which slice of the visible tickets a queue shows.

RequesterAction.description: Explicit decisions only: replies and views never implicitly accept a proposal.

stale.description: Filters to drop when applying: the rest still work as saved.

Screenshot.description:
Metadata of a validated screenshot. The bytes are only served by the
preview/download endpoints.

byte_size.description: Size of the stored, re-encoded file.

body.description: Plain text, 1–10,000 characters, nonblank. HTML and Markdown are not interpreted.

idempotency_key.description: New UUID per send. Reuse the UUID and exact input to retry safely.

screenshot_ids.description: Own pending screenshot uploads (at most 10, distinct).

SmtpConnection.description: Masked connection. The username and password are never included.

last_delivery_error.description: Stable code from the last background delivery failure, if any.

password_set.description:
Always true when a connection exists: a username and password are stored.
Neither value is returned.

SmtpSecurity.description:
How the relay expects the connection to be encrypted. There is no plaintext
or opportunistic mode: certificate verification stays on.

username.description:
Required when creating the connection or changing the host, so stored
credentials are never sent to a new server. Omit to keep the stored value.

to.description: Recipient. Must be the acting Admin's email or the configured sender address.

StaffAccess.description:
Affordances for the staff view, from the same rules the write endpoints
enforce. Clients hide controls with them; the server rechecks every write.

assignees.description:
Eligible assignees: active staff members of the ticket's team other than
the requester and the current assignee (empty unless `can_assign`).

can_assign.description: (Re)assign or unassign within the ticket's team (its Team Lead or an Admin).

can_dispatch.description: Send to another team or return to the general queue.

can_handle.description:
Staff reply, internal note, status work, resolution proposal, and priority
changes: the ticket is open, in a team, and the caller is in charge of it.

can_reopen.description:
The ticket is closed with operator resolution, the Admin toggle is on, and
the caller is in charge of it.

dispatch_teams.description: Active teams the ticket can be sent to (empty unless `can_dispatch`).

oneOf.description: `summary` is requester-visible, 1–5000 characters. Supersedes a pending proposal.
Only while the Admin reopening toggle is on.

StaffAction.description:
Staff work on a ticket. Every action carries the `updated_at` the client last
loaded; a newer change (reply, status, priority) is `409 conflict`.

StaleFilter.description: A filter that no longer applies to the caller.

SubmissionReceipt.description:
Immutable submission receipt. A replay returns the original submitted status;
read `/api/tickets/{id}` for the current status.

idempotency_key.description: Generate once per logical submission; retain across network retries.

requester_skip.description: A request, never a bypass authority. The lifecycle checks current policy.

SubmittedIntake.description:
Original intake, frozen when submission commits; current effective priority
stays on the ticket independently of the initial catalog selection here.

TicketActivity.description: A cheap change marker for an open ticket page (docs/lifecycle.md "Refreshing").

version.description:
Opaque digest; compare for equality only. Changes with every status, team,
assignee, or priority change, every message the caller may read, and the
caller's own role or team (so open pages refresh their capabilities). It is
not a counter, so it does not reveal how many staff-only events exist.

TicketAssignmentView.description:
Public handling details shown to a ticket's requester. `team_name: null`
means the shared general queue; `assignee_display_name: null` means unassigned.

TicketDetail.description: One ticket as the caller may see it.

assignment_changes.description: Dispatch and assignment history, oldest first; staff view only (empty for the requester).

confirmation_deadline.description: Auto-close time of the pending proposal; set only while `awaiting_confirmation`.

oneOf.description: Frozen original intake; null only for legacy records predating submission.

priority_changes.description: Staff-only effective-priority history, oldest first; empty in requester responses.

proposal_version.description:
Version of the latest staff resolution proposal (0 = none). Requester
decisions send it back.

oneOf.description: Staff view only; `null` in the requester view.
What the caller may do as staff; `null` in the requester view.

view.description:
`requester` when the caller submitted it (public data only, whatever their
role); `staff` for authorized staff.

TicketIntake.description:
Full replacement of editable draft input. Missing fields have empty defaults;
category/priority and required answers are checked against the catalog at submission.

answers.description: Up to 100 conditional answers, keyed by field ID.

description.description: Up to 20,000 characters; required on submission.

screenshot_ids.description: Up to 10 distinct pending uploads of this account (`POST /api/screenshots`).

subject.description: Up to 200 characters; required on submission.

TicketSummary.description: Minimal requester history. No staff-only metadata; all roles see only their own.

TicketTransition.description: One immutable status transition (`ticket_events` row with a `to_status`).

actor_account_id.description: Staff view only; `null` for background jobs and in the requester view.

actor_display_name.description: Current display name of the actor; staff view only.

payload.description:
Public details: `route` (queue entry reason), `resolution_source`,
`closure_reason`, `proposal_version`, `summary`, `timeout_hours`,
`deadline`, or the cancellation `reason`.

TicketView.description: Which representation of a ticket the actor may read.

expertise.description: Descriptive only; only Specialist accounts may have expertise. Maximum 120 characters.

team_id.description: One current team; null removes membership. Users/Admins must use null.

email.description: Contact address; omitted keeps the current one.

oneOf.description: Interface and email language; omitted keeps the current one.

archived.description: Archiving clears leadership, memberships and assignments, retaining all history.

lead_account_id.description: Required for active teams; null when archiving. A lead must be active with team_lead role.
